newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ASTRA TUMBLES ON H1 OPERATING PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: ASTRA TUMBLES ON H1 OPERATING PROFIT.

text.p: Shares in Swedish drugs major Astra tumbled on Friday after it posted a slightly lower than expected pre-tax profit for the first six months of the year.
At 0950 GMT the share price was eight crowns lower at 144.5. It had been trading about one crown down ahead of the report.
"The pre-tax was a little lower than expected but it seems to be the operating profit that is most down on expectations," said one analyst.
Astra posted a four percent rise in pre-tax profit to 7.01 billion crowns against expectations of 7.18 billion crowns while sales rose 13 percent to 21.47 billion crowns.
Its operating profit rose to 6.75 billion crowns from 6.30 billion crowns.
